# centralizer　`def.centralizer`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.centralizer)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.centralizer.md)

## Notes · **draft**
⭐ Relation to the normalizer: $C_G(S) \trianglelefteq N_G(S)$, and $C_G(S) \subseteq N_G(S)$ (commuting with every element of $S$ certainly preserves it as a set).

⭐ Examples: in $GL_n(K)$ the centralizer of a scalar matrix is all of the invertible matrices (scalar matrices lie in the center); in $S_3$, $C_{S_3}((12)) = \{e, (12)\}$.

⭐ In the class equation, the size of a noncentral conjugacy class is $[G : C_G(x)]$, see `thm.class-equation`.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
